app.name: NIS2 Compass
app.description: Classify your entity, build the required documentation and audit your network — guided end to end.

landing.title: Know your NIS2 obligations. Then meet them.
landing.subtitle: NIS2 Compass helps you determine whether the directive applies, assemble the required documentation, and audit your IT environment — with Romanian and English guidance from day one.

classification.title: Entity classification
classification.description: A data-driven questionnaire applies the NIS2 size and sector rules, shows the legal basis, and explains the supervision regime.

documents.title: Documentation centre
documents.description: Guided templates for the Art. 21 measures, versioned revisions, approvals and professional DOCX/PDF exports.

audit.title: Security audit
audit.description: Map your network, assess every device, track findings and export an audit report that maps back to NIS2 requirements.

landing.statusBody: The monorepo, design tokens, bilingual shell and API foundation are in place. Authentication, classification and documents follow in the next phases.

statusItems.i18n: English and Romanian from day one
statusItems.api: NestJS API shell with Prisma, Redis and health checks

design.title: Design system
design.subtitle: The visual language shared by the application, DOCX and PDF exports.
design.paletteHint: Hue 206 throughout. primary-600 is the base and the minimum step for normal text on white (6.8:1).
design.severityHint: Fixed colors across the UI and every export: Low, Medium, High, Critical.
design.typographyHint: System font stack with Inter as the preferred face; no external font request.
design.progressHint: Progress bars use the warning → primary → success gradient.
design.formattingHint: Dates, numbers and currency follow the active locale.
design.accessibilityBody: Focus rings, keyboard navigation, semantic landmarks and reduced-motion support are built in. The target is WCAG 2.2 AA.

footer.disclaimer: This tool supports compliance preparation and does not constitute legal advice.
